description: A walk-round access test of Merrin & Sallow for colleagues who know Break Escape: doors and cards, sign-in PCs and their owners, saved credentials, a drop box on a wall port, a pivot to a second network, a keystroke injector, an evil-twin access point and the clean-up. Slice 1: rooms, doors, locks and cast only.
test_objective: Show the access and network model in one office: the seven rooms, their doors and locks, and the cast, ready for the later slices' accounts, devices and office life
